confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied calibration cities; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain given July peak-season variability. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the local draft-beer relationship (cocktail a bit over twice beer, wine a little above beer) because direct bar pricing knowledge is weaker. FX was taken from RBA exchange-rate listing text returned by two web searches; the rba.gov.au table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated mainly against Bucharest as the closest supplied comparable: most Tbilisi meal, drink and hostel anchors sit somewhat below Bucharest levels, while the private hostel room and three-star hotel sit roughly level with it. Helsinki and Berlin are well above Tbilisi on every anchor. Georgia is transcontinental (Caucasus) and is grouped under Europe here because the supplied comparables are European and travel budgeting usually treats it that way.
